name: ninety
description: Tu diario futbolero — guarda y revive todos los partidos que has visto

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:budget: npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.check:audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix backend --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix frontend --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.seed:demo: npm run generate:test-photos --prefix backend && npm run seed:demo --prefix backend
scripts.test:v1: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run demo:flow --prefix backend
scripts.test:e2e:og: npm run build --prefix frontend && playwright test --config=playwright.og.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:demo: playwright test e2e/smoke/demo-showcase.spec.ts e2e/smoke/public.spec.ts e2e/smoke/social-engagement.spec.ts e2e/smoke/collections.spec.ts --grep "demo|Favoritos|me gusta|también|showcase|Actividad"
scripts.test:demo: npm run test:demo-seed --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e:demo
scripts.test:qa: npm test && npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test:e2e:public && npm run test:e2e:og && npm run test:e2e:boundary
scripts.test:qa:full: npm run test:qa && npm run test:demo
scripts.test:ci: npm run check:secrets && npm run check:supabase && npm run check:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run check:dead-code && npm test && npm run test:security --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
